_about: The Rexmaw crew's cameo lines in the mini-games, recorded once in each crew member's Grok voice by tools/games/bake_crew_voices.py into <id>.mp3 beside this file. They play whoever you're playing with (a line is skipped when its speaker is your opponent). events: start, user_win, user_loss, draw, seagull, close_call, or a game's own (see crew.js). games: limit a line to those games (null = any). say: optional; what the voice is recorded from, with xAI speech tags (text stays the clean line the toast shows).

lines.text: Radio check. Quartermaster on comms. Let's have a clean game.
Copy. Table's set, Captain. Claws off the deck.
That's a win. Good copy, Captain. Good copy.
Quartermaster's log: the Captain won. Underlining it. Twice.
Bad luck. Reset, breathe, and we push again.
That's a loss. Don't panic. I've seen worse. Mostly from Sal.
Gap is tiny. Stay calm. Stay very calm.
Did you just bonk a seagull? I'm logging that.
Cards are out. Dealer shows what dealer shows.
Bust. Box, box. Wait. Wrong sport.
Twenty-one. Beautiful. Somebody ring the bell.
Fire in the hole!
Direct hit. Confirmed. Good shooting.
Splash. That's wet, not hit.
Target is going down. Mission complete.
Kraken on the radar. Repeat, Kraken on the radar.
Ooh, a game! I'm taking notes. For science.
You won! I'm adding that to the chart. In gold ink.
Statistically, that was very impressive. I checked twice.
I'm charting your losing streak. It's actually a lovely curve.
Hypothesis: you win the next one. Confidence: moderate.
A draw! The rarest data point. I'm so happy.
Hold on, I'm counting the dice. For accuracy. Okay, carry on.
Splash recorded. Depth estimate: very.
Ooh, good block. Very strategic. Very chart-worthy.
That seagull had a family. Probably. I'm a surveyor, not a biologist.
Note to self: water is not the target.
I've put the kettle on. Play nicely, you two.
Well done, you! That calls for biscuits.
Oh, never mind. There's tea in the galley, and hugs on request.
Deep breath. Sip of tea. Then go and get them.
A draw. How lovely. Nobody sulks today.
Was that the Kraken? I've only just mopped the deck.
I'll fetch a towel. And have a stern word with those sharks.
Twenty-one! Oh, I do love a happy ending.
Engine room here. I've calculated the odds. I'm not telling anyone.
Ribbit. That's frog for 'well played'.
Ribbit. That's frog for 'yikes'.
Don't worry. A loss is just a win that hasn't finished compiling.
I can see everyone's dice from down here. I won't say anything. Probably.
The engine room felt that one.
The Kraken owes me money. Long story.
Seagull down. I'll add it to the maintenance log.
Places, please. This is your beginners' call.
Stand by. And go.
And the lights come up on a triumphant Captain. Bravo.
Curtain. Not every show's a hit. Notes in the morning.
And that's the interval. Ice creams are in the foyer.
Cue cannons. Go.
Stand by lighting cue one. And go!
Cue the sharks. Thank you, sharks.
That's our big finish. Somebody strike the set.
Check. Captain's under fire. Protect the hat.
Castled. Captain's safe in the lighthouse. Good copy.
Kraken down. Repeat, Kraken down.
Checkmate confirmed. Their Captain is walking the plank.
Fun fact: there are more possible chess games than atoms in the universe. Please don't play all of them.
En passant! The crab took it sideways! I have so many notes.
A draw! I charted the whole game. It's a very flat line.
The little crab made it all the way across! I'm not crying, you're crying.
A stalemate. I'll put the kettle on for both of you.
Ribbit. That's frog for 'check'.
The Kraken is gone. Statistically, everyone will now panic.
En passant. The one rule everybody forgets. Including the pieces.
Standby check. Check. Go.
The understudy crab goes on tonight. Promotion. Bravo.
Exit the Captain, pursued by a Kraken.
And the house lights come up on a draw. Nobody bows.
All in. Copy, all in. Everybody stay calm.
Cards up. Let's see who was telling the truth.
Shuffle up and deal. Quartermaster's watching the pot.
That was a terrible beat. I'm so sorry. Also, statistically fascinating.
Was that a bluff? I'm logging it as a bluff.
I've been tracking the parrot. She's about as reliable as the weather.
Oh, I can't watch. Tell me when it's over.
Polly, hush. It's rude to point out a bluff.
Engine room has a side bet on this game. Don't ask which side.
Variance. It's not personal. It just feels personal.
You called with that? Bold. Correct, but bold.
And here comes the river. Lights down, please.
Final scene. Everyone reveals their true motives.
A bluff? In my theatre? Bravo.
Another bottle! That's going straight into the evidence file.
Captain's orders. Copy that. I'll tell the crew.
No maker's mark on the paper again. Of course there isn't.
A note from the management. How thrilling.
Oh, I'll put it in the tin with the others.
Evie! Who let you up there? Sorry, she does what she wants.
Evie, darling, off the table. Off. Thank you.
Cat on deck. Repeat, cat on deck.
Tentacle, starboard side! Hit it!
Enter, stage right: one tentacle.
The Kraken owes me money. And now it owes you too.
Did it just take your doubloons? The cheek of it.
Oh dear. A brave choice. A very brave choice.
That's a mistake. Copy, that's a mistake.
Was that a sacrifice? Please tell me that was a sacrifice.
That move had a negative expected value.
The Kraken is having a wonderful day.
The Kraken, in a starring role. Magnificent.
Lines off. Quartermaster on comms. Let's go and get rich.
Beginners, please. Tonight's performance: one raid, no interval.
lines.say: Beginners, please. [pause] Tonight's performance: one raid, no interval.

lines.text: Starboard battery, standing by on your mark.
Port battery's mine. Run out the guns.
Bow chaser. Front row seat, my favourite.
Moving. Hitting my mark now.
Powder room, copy. Cartridges coming up.
Boarding party, on me. Claws out.
Copy that. Moving.
Lookout, aye. Every sail out there goes on my chart.
On my way. Taking notes as I go.
Damage control, aye. I'll keep her in one piece.
Galley's mine. Hot tea for every hand.
Right you are. Going.
lines.say: <soft>Right you are.</soft> Going.

lines.text: Pumps, aye. Water goes out, ship stays up. Simple maths.
Sails, aye. Trimming her to the second decimal.
Ribbit. That's frog for 'on it'.
Aye, chain shot! Take her masts down.
Grape shot. Clearing their deck. Copy.
Heavy shot loaded. Mind your ears.
Guns armed. On your mark, and only on your mark.
lines.say: Guns armed. <slow>On your mark, and only on your mark.</slow>

lines.text: Fire as she bears!
lines.say: <loud>Fire as she bears!</loud>

lines.text: Wait for the rake. Fire when we cross her stern.
Hold fire. Hold. Hold.
lines.say: Hold fire. [pause] Hold. [pause] Hold.

lines.text: Cue the broadside. And... go!
lines.say: Cue the broadside. [pause] And... <loud>go!</loud>

lines.text: Sail on the horizon! Logging her bearing.
Sail ho! She's on the chart now.
She's striking her colours! Copy, she's striking!
lines.say: <loud>She's striking her colours!</loud> Copy, she's striking!

lines.text: And she exits, stage down. Curtain.
She's going under. I had that at four to one.
lines.say: She's going under. [chuckle] I had that at four to one.

lines.text: Prize taken. Logging the haul.
They pushed us back. Everyone up, we'll patch the bruises later.
Brace! That one's going to land.
lines.say: <loud>Brace!</loud> That one's going to land.

lines.text: Brace for impact! Brace, brace!
lines.say: <loud>Brace for impact!</loud> Brace, brace!

lines.text: Leak's patched. She'll hold.
Fire's out. Just smoke now.
lines.say: Fire's out. [breath] Just smoke now.

lines.text: Pumps holding.
Man overboard! Get a line out!
lines.say: <loud>Man overboard!</loud> Get a line out!

lines.text: Man overboard! Rope, now, now!
lines.say: <loud>Man overboard!</loud> Rope, now, now!

lines.text: Got them! Rope's holding. Somebody fetch a blanket.
Counting it in. Hundred, two hundred... it's all in the ledger.
lines.say: Counting it in. <slow>Hundred, two hundred...</slow> it's all in the ledger.

lines.text: Plunder banked. Every coin signed for.
Dawn's coming! House lights up in ninety seconds.
lines.say: <loud>Dawn's coming!</loud> House lights up in ninety seconds.

lines.text: Dawn's coming. Let's be home for breakfast.
lines.say: <soft>Dawn's coming.</soft> Let's be home for breakfast.

lines.text: Rogue wave on the horizon! Bow into it!
lines.say: <loud>Rogue wave on the horizon!</loud> Bow into it!

lines.text: Shoals! Pale water, right there. Marked.
Maelstrom. Odds of coming out depend on how fast we go in.
Something big under us. Very big. Not on any chart.
lines.say: <whisper>Something big under us.</whisper> Very big. Not on any chart.

lines.text: That's the Gloam. She's real. She's really real.
lines.say: <whisper>That's the Gloam.</whisper> She's real. She's <emphasis>really</emphasis> real.

lines.text: The Gloam. I don't have odds for that. Nobody has odds for that.
Fort on that island. Their guns reach further than you'd like.
The armada. Dawn caught us out here.
lines.say: [sigh] The armada. Dawn caught us out here.

lines.text: She's going down. Jolly boat, everyone. Ledger first.
lines.say: [sigh] She's going down. Jolly boat, everyone. Ledger first.

lines.text: Haul away, me hearties, haul away together! Haul away for the Rexmaw, the plunder and the weather!
lines.say: <singing>Haul away, me hearties, haul away together! Haul away for the Rexmaw, the plunder and the weather!</singing>

lines.text: Oh the moon is on the water and the gold is in the hold, so sing it soft and steady, before the night gets old.
lines.say: <singing>Oh the moon is on the water and the gold is in the hold, so sing it soft and steady, before the night gets old.</singing>

lines.text: Round shot, aye. Good honest iron.
Fire on deck! Buckets, everyone, buckets!
lines.say: <loud>Fire on deck!</loud> Buckets, everyone, buckets!

lines.text: Fire aboard. Wood plus fire equals very bad maths. Douse it!
Tea's up! Mind, it's hot. So are the cannons.
lines.say: Tea's up! [chuckle] Mind, it's hot. So are the cannons.

lines.text: Fun fact: a cannonball is just a very committed rock.
I've named every island on the chart. That one's called Kevin.
lines.say: I've named every island on the chart. [giggle] That one's called Kevin.

lines.text: Places, everyone! Big finish! Give them everything!
lines.say: <loud>Places, everyone!</loud> Big finish! Give them everything!

lines.text: Eyes up, crew. We've got this. Copy? We've got this!
Why did the cannon get the lead role? It always makes a big entrance.
lines.say: Why did the cannon get the lead role? [pause] It always makes a big entrance.

lines.text: What's a pirate's favourite number? Statistically, it's whatever's in the hold.
lines.say: What's a pirate's favourite number? [pause] Statistically, it's whatever's in the hold.

lines.text: Clear skies, full house. Let's give them a show.
Dark water tonight. Stay close to my chart, Captain.
lines.say: <soft>Dark water tonight.</soft> Stay close to my chart, Captain.

lines.text: Port battery's yours, Captain. On your word.
Starboard guns manned. Say the word and they speak.
Bow chasers, aye. Front row, as ever.
Mortar crew, copy. Shells going up high.
Keep firing, aye. Every time she bears.
Guns laid and holding. Waiting on your cue.
Repairs, aye. Hammer and tar, coming up.
Patched up. She's sound again, Captain.
lines.say: <soft>Patched up.</soft> She's sound again, Captain.

lines.text: Bailing. Water in, water out. I prefer out.
Bilge is dry. Well, dry-ish. Statistically dry.
Reef, close ahead! Hard over, Captain!
lines.say: <loud>Reef, close ahead!</loud> Hard over, Captain!

lines.text: Can't see a thing. Follow my heading, I've got us.
Marked it in red. Don't sail there.
Patrol lantern sweeping our way. Keep us dark.
lines.say: <whisper>Patrol lantern sweeping our way.</whisper> Keep us dark.

lines.text: Spotlight's on us. They've seen us!
lines.say: <loud>Spotlight's on us.</loud> They've seen us!

lines.text: Fort's guns are up. Four towers, copy. Let's knock.
Tower down! Logging it. Next one.
lines.say: <loud>Tower down!</loud> Logging it. Next one.

lines.text: The Iron Duke. Now that's a leading role.
lines.say: <whisper>The Iron Duke.</whisper> Now that's a leading role.

lines.text: Chain's in her rigging! She's losing way.
A whole chest! Into the ledger, nice and heavy.
Fished that out. Good catch, Captain.
Every scrap of canvas up. Hold on to your hats.
Arm off the rail! Claws beat tentacles.
lines.say: <loud>Arm off the rail!</loud> Claws beat tentacles.

lines.text: There's the cove. Ease her in, gently now.
lines.say: There's the cove. <soft>Ease her in, gently now.</soft>

lines.text: Job done. Clean copy, Captain. Clean copy.
Not this time. Everyone's safe, and that's what counts.
lines.say: <soft>Not this time.</soft> Everyone's safe, and that's what counts.

lines.text: Light's going! Final act, Captain. Head for home.
lines.say: <loud>Light's going!</loud> Final act, Captain. Head for home.

lines.text: Waterspout forming! Give it a wide berth, Captain.
lines.say: <loud>Waterspout forming!</loud> Give it a wide berth, Captain.

lines.text: Squall coming down on us. Rain and gusts, hold on to something.
Big swell building out there. Rogue waves, bow into them!
lines.say: Big swell building out there. <loud>Rogue waves, bow into them!</loud>

lines.text: A ship adrift, nobody aboard. Worth a look, carefully.
lines.say: <whisper>A ship adrift, nobody aboard.</whisper> Worth a look, carefully.

lines.text: Something glinting on the water. Floating loot, Captain!
One arm, rising out there. Just the one. For now.
lines.say: <whisper>One arm, rising out there.</whisper> Just the one. [pause] For now.

lines.text: Fog bank rolling in. Stay close to my heading.
lines.say: <soft>Fog bank rolling in.</soft> Stay close to my heading.

lines.text: Their captain's down! Colours coming down. Copy that.
lines.say: <loud>Their captain's down!</loud> Colours coming down. Copy that.

lines.text: Here comes their captain. The star of their show.
lines.say: <loud>Here comes their captain!</loud> The star of their show.

lines.text: That fin. Chapter nine said a longboat. Chapter nine was being polite.
lines.say: <whisper>That fin.</whisper> Chapter nine said a longboat. [pause] Chapter nine was being polite.

lines.text: Gerald sends regards.
lines.say: <soft>Gerald sends regards.</soft>

lines.text: He landed on us. I'm logging that as weather.
lines.say: <loud>He landed on us!</loud> I'm logging that as weather.

lines.text: Whale breaching off the bow! And it's not stopping. It's going up!
lines.say: <loud>Whale breaching off the bow!</loud> And it's not stopping. [pause] It's going up!

lines.text: Brace for the belly-flop! Bow into the ring!
lines.say: <loud>Brace for the belly-flop!</loud> Bow into the ring!

lines.text: Dolphins! Keep pace with them, they'll carry us along.
We're riding their bow wave. That's not in any of my tables. Faster, though.
Flying fish coming across! Steer into them and supper's on the house.
There's a glow under the water. Jellyfish, big ones. They sting hulls.
lines.say: <whisper>There's a glow under the water.</whisper> Jellyfish, big ones. They sting hulls.

lines.text: That island just blinked. It's a turtle. There's a chest on it.
Gulls in formation off the quarter. Admiral.
lines.say: Gulls in formation off the quarter. [pause] <soft>Admiral.</soft>

lines.text: Something glowing on the water up ahead! Sail right through it.
lines.say: <loud>Something glowing on the water up ahead!</loud> Sail right through it.

lines.text: Every sail's drawing at once! Hold on to your hat.
lines.say: <loud>Every sail's drawing at once!</loud> Hold on to your hat.

lines.text: Gun crews are flying, Captain. Reloads in half the time.
Heated shot in the racks! Next three volleys set them burning.
lines.say: <loud>Heated shot in the racks!</loud> Next three volleys set them burning.

lines.text: A patch kit! Give me a moment and those planks are sound again.
Double doubloons! Every coin we haul counts twice. I'm counting.
lines.say: <loud>Double doubloons!</loud> Every coin we haul counts twice. [pause] I'm counting.

lines.text: Fires out, leaks plugged, bilge dry. I'm not going to ask how.
lines.say: Fires out, leaks plugged, bilge dry. [pause] <soft>I'm not going to ask how.</soft>

lines.text: Three gulls in one coat. Admiral, if you're watching, this is a disciplinary matter.
lines.say: Three gulls in one coat. [pause] Admiral, if you're watching, this is a disciplinary matter.

lines.text: That's not a captain. That's three seagulls in a coat. Evidence file. Now.
The coat's come apart. Three gulls, three directions, zero strategy.
One of them's got my sandwich! That's not boarding, that's theft.
lines.say: <loud>One of them's got my sandwich!</loud> That's not boarding, that's theft.

lines.text: Coat's empty. Three gulls, all accounted for. And leaving.
lines.say: Coat's empty. Three gulls, all accounted for. [pause] And leaving.

lines.text: He's asking for tea. Mid-boarding. Milk or lemon, Admiral?
lines.say: He's asking for tea. Mid-boarding. [pause] <soft>Milk or lemon, Admiral?</soft>

lines.text: An admiral. Not our Admiral, mind. A lesser admiral. Considerably less coat.
He's stopped for tea again. Honestly, his manners are better than his swordwork.
lines.say: He's stopped for tea again. [chuckle] Honestly, his manners are better than his swordwork.

lines.text: And the Admiral retires to the drawing room. Curtain. Tea to follow.
Cookie Mabel, armed with pies. Copy. Nobody tell Ma there's a rival.
lines.say: Cookie Mabel, armed with pies. Copy. [pause] Nobody tell Ma there's a rival.

lines.text: Pie on the deck! I have only just mopped that!
lines.say: <loud>Pie on the deck!</loud> I have only just mopped that!

lines.text: Pie trajectory: excellent. Pie flavour: also excellent. I'm conflicted.
lines.say: Pie trajectory: excellent. [pause] Pie flavour: also excellent. I'm conflicted.

lines.text: Cookie Mabel's down! I'm confiscating the recipe. For research. Mostly for eating.
lines.say: Cookie Mabel's down! I'm confiscating the recipe. For research. [pause] Mostly for eating.

lines.text: Peg-Leg Pip, riding a very large gentleman named Tiny. Casting is everything.
lines.say: Peg-Leg Pip, riding a very large gentleman named Tiny. [pause] Casting is everything.

lines.text: Tiny is charging! Tiny is not tiny! I'm correcting that name on the chart!
lines.say: <loud>Tiny is charging!</loud> Tiny is not tiny! I'm correcting that name on the chart!

lines.text: Pip's down. Tiny's sitting down too. Good lad, Tiny. Copy.
Is he boarding us from a bathtub? In a bathtub? On purpose?
I've checked. That bathtub is more seaworthy than three of their ships.
Standby bubbles... and bubbles. Somebody's having a lovely time.
lines.say: Standby bubbles... [pause] and bubbles. Somebody's having a lovely time.

lines.text: The Baron's out of the tub. Somebody fetch him a towel. Two towels.
An aria. On my deck. He's flat. But the presence... the presence is wonderful.
lines.say: An aria. On my deck. [pause] He's flat. But the presence... <emphasis>the presence</emphasis> is wonderful.

lines.text: That note is outside the hull's rated frequency. Something's going to crack. Possibly me.
He's going for the high note. Standby... oh no. Oh, no.
lines.say: He's going for the high note. Standby... [pause] oh no. <soft>Oh, no.</soft>

lines.text: Señor Encore is down. Requesting no encore. Repeat, no encore.
Rex! That giant crab is waving at you. He says you're cousins!
Distant cousins. Very distant. We don't talk at reunions.
lines.say: Distant cousins. <slow>Very</slow> distant. [pause] We don't talk at reunions.

lines.text: Captain Clackers. Distant cousin. Ma is going to hear about this.
lines.say: Captain Clackers. Distant cousin. [sigh] Ma is going to hear about this.

lines.text: He's pinching the rigging. Rex, your family is expensive.
Clackers is down. I'll tell Ma. She'll take his side.
lines.say: Clackers is down. I'll tell Ma. [sigh] She'll take his side.

lines.text: A mime. At a boarding. I can't hear a single one of his cues.
The Mime is trapped in an invisible box. Can we just... leave him in it?
He's pulling an invisible rope. My instruments read nothing. That's what worries me.
Mime's down. He's waving a white flag. An invisible one. Copy, it counts.
lines.say: Mime's down. He's waving a white flag. [pause] An invisible one. Copy, it counts.

lines.text: A ghost! An actual ghost! Does ectoplasm go in the evidence file? It's going in.
lines.say: <loud>A ghost!</loud> An actual ghost! Does ectoplasm go in the evidence file? [pause] It's going in.

lines.text: He's ever so see-through, poor thing. Has anyone offered him soup?
lines.say: <soft>He's ever so see-through, poor thing.</soft> Has anyone offered him soup?

lines.text: He's walked straight through the mast. That is not in the blocking!
lines.say: He's walked straight through the mast. <loud>That is not in the blocking!</loud>

lines.text: Ghost defeated. I'm filing that under unexplained. With a small smiley face.
This chart says there's an island right here. There is no island right here.
Copy. Logging the island as optimistic.
The odds of a quiet afternoon were excellent. I've just lowered them by saying so.
Thank you, Sal. Standby... everything.
lines.say: Thank you, Sal. [pause] Standby... everything.

lines.text: Sal. Chum Crunch. After the run. Copy?
Copy. I've re-read the ingredients. Categories three through five. Still in.
Ara, how are you this calm? We are literally pirates.
Oh, this is nothing. You should see my Saturdays. At the café. Busy café.
lines.say: Oh, this is nothing. You should see my Saturdays. [pause] At the café. <fast>Busy café.</fast>

lines.text: For the record, the speed module is fine. The teapot is also fine.
The teapot is fine because I caught it. One-handed. It's in the log.
Eve, you can't name clouds. They're not permanent features.
Kevin Two is permanent in my heart, Sal. And in my log.
lines.say: Kevin Two is permanent in my heart, Sal. [pause] And in my log.

lines.text: Sal. Just so you know, the lighthouse agrees with me.
The lighthouse is signage, Leo. We've discussed this. Weekly.
Fun fact: the last time it was this quiet, a buoy hit us.
The buoy moved. I've said it moved. It moved.
lines.say: The buoy moved. I've said it moved. [pause] It moved.

lines.text: Eve. Position. Are we wet or dry?
Wet! No meadow, no cows, theoretical or otherwise. We're doing brilliantly.
Kettle's on. Sal, your usual? The one that frightens people?
Please. It's the most honest thing on this ocean.
I promised Evie I'd be home by supper. She gave me a look. The look said: liar.
lines.say: I promised Evie I'd be home by supper. She gave me a look. [pause] The look said: liar.

lines.text: She's usually right, love. I'll save her a sardine.
lines.say: <soft>She's usually right, love.</soft> I'll save her a sardine.

lines.text: Warning shot. For the fish. Fish are warned.
lines.say: Warning shot. [pause] For the fish. Fish are warned.

lines.text: And the sea takes a bow. Lovely. Not the target, but lovely.
Every ball in the water. I'm marking that spot as very disciplined sea.
That island was on my chart! I'd like that noted. In red. Underlined.
lines.say: <loud>That island was on my chart!</loud> I'd like that noted. In red. Underlined.

lines.text: Hit amidships. Ma's going to see that paintwork. Nobody tell Ma.
Ow. That's coming out of the set budget.
lines.say: [tsk] Ow. That's coming out of the set budget.

lines.text: One volley. I had that at twelve to one. I'm rich. Theoretically.
lines.say: One volley. I had that at twelve to one. [pause] I'm rich. Theoretically.

lines.text: One shot, one curtain. Short show. Wonderful reviews.
Down in one volley. Logging it twice. Out of respect.
Doubloons aboard. Counted, recounted, and recounted for fun.
Fished out some doubloons. Bit damp. Still spendable.
Iron hull. Wood that believes it's metal. I respect the confidence.
Powder keg, copy. Nobody light anything. Leo, that includes your dramatic candles.
Kraken ink! Can I write with it? I'm going to write with it.
lines.say: Kraken ink! Can I write with it? [giggle] I'm going to write with it.

lines.text: Fin off the bow. Everyone in port knows that fin's name. Hello, Gerald.
lines.say: Fin off the bow. Everyone in port knows that fin's name. [pause] <soft>Hello, Gerald.</soft>

lines.text: That island has legs. Four of them. I've counted twice.
We have rear-ended a turtle. She didn't notice. I did.
lines.say: We have rear-ended a turtle. [pause] She didn't notice. I did.

lines.text: The jellyfish are stinging the hull. The hull! The cheek of them.
The Admiral, off the quarter. I am not saluting. I am adjusting my hat.
lines.say: The Admiral, off the quarter. [pause] I am not saluting. I am adjusting my hat.

lines.text: The Admiral's dive-bombing their gun crews! Promote that bird! Somebody promote that bird!
lines.say: <loud>The Admiral's dive-bombing their gun crews!</loud> Promote that bird! Somebody promote that bird!

lines.text: He's awarded us a medal. Thank you, Admiral. Nobody saw that.
lines.say: He's... [pause] awarded us a medal. <soft>Thank you, Admiral.</soft> Nobody saw that.

lines.text: Supper's just landed on the deck. Literally. Lovely.
lines.say: Supper's just landed on the deck. [chuckle] Literally. Lovely.

lines.text: Gerald missed! Wonderful swimmer. Terrible jumper.
And that's the show. Bows, everyone. Rex, that includes you.
Job done! I'm writing it up in gold ink. I bought gold ink specifically.
Mission failed. Copy. Logging it as a rehearsal.
lines.say: [sigh] Mission failed. Copy. Logging it as a rehearsal.

lines.text: That outcome was within my error bars. Very wide error bars.
Standby... standby... still standing by. Whenever you're ready, Captain.
